chunks: What al-Shaykh, may Allah the Exalted support him, informed me of, from Abū al-Qāsim Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad, from Muḥammad ibn Yaʿqūb, from Muḥammad ibn Yaḥyā, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from Muʿāwiyah ibn Ḥukaym, from al-Muʿallā Abī ʿUthmān, from Abī Baṣīr, who said:

I entered upon Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام while he was performing salat (prayer). My guide said to me, “There is blood on his garment.” Then when he had finished, I said to him, “My guide informed me that there is blood on your garment.” He said: “I have boils, and I do not wash my garment until they heal.”
ai.seo_question: Can one pray with blood on the garment due to boils or a continuous bodily condition?
ai.summary: This hadith reports that Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام prayed while blood was on his garment due to boils on his body. It indicates a jurisprudential ruling concerning impurity on clothing in a case of ongoing bodily ailment and recurring blood.
